summary: Saltcorn is an open-source platform designed for building database-driven web and mobile applications without traditional coding. It combines user interface design, data backends, workflows, and document generation into a single system under an MIT licence.
goodFor: It suits developers and technical administrators who need to rapidly prototype or deploy internal database applications using a self-hosted stack.
watchOut: The platform has a moderate maintenance health score and lacks tagged releases, which may introduce risks regarding stability and upgrade paths for production environments.
deployNotes: You can deploy it using Docker with Node.js, which typically requires configuring persistent storage for your database and setting up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
